description: Parkour candidate list owner (ACU-RE-0055 follow-up). ACU.exe 748abdc6...7e40, base 0x140000000; guards from the mapped image (motion-link-20261020). Every selection call (0x140133B00) returns to 0x140134987 inside 0x140134880, a virtual in 54 vtables (0x1439E06E0..0x143A34B80) that calls the selection through vtbl+0x4F0 and then clears the list. Its return address names the code that filled the list. Entry: r9 (a4) is a vector whose |v|^2 < 0.01 falls back to [[rcx+0x118]+0x18] (snapshot 16 B); the 9th argument [rsp+0x48] is the candidate SmallArray (gather as in parkour_selection). Selection exit 0x140133D4B gives the chosen index. 0x1401B1770 = fancy slot 1 (record r9, 256 B) and 0x14019F920 = slot 0x47 entry (r9, 16 B, copied to rcx+0x30) test the two known candidate writers. register_index: 0=rcx 3=r9 6=rsi 9=rsp.
